title: Anthropic connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Anthropic request-reply sink's settings, read by the native protocols family (`loams_connector_protocols::anthropic`, CN2 Task 21): one call per event, the answer a reply event on `reply_topic` (R-CN2-3, OR-19). `api_key` holds a secret **name** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`; a reply never carries it.

model.description: The model; there is no default.

api_key.description: The API key, sent as `x-api-key`. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

prompt.description: Templates filled from the event (`{{/pointer}}`, `{{data}}`, `{{subject}}`, `{{id}}`, `{{type}}`, `{{source}}`); a placeholder with nothing to fill is Poison (R21.10).

params.description: Fixed request fields merged into every body; they may not set model, messages, system, max_tokens, max_completion_tokens or stream.

base_url.description: The API root, for a gateway or a fixture; `https://api.anthropic.com` when omitted.

reply_topic.description: Where replies go: one reply event per input, `io.loams.dev.flow.anthropic.reply.v1` with id `<input id>/reply`, keeping the input's subject and carrying `loamsinreplyto`/`loamsinreplytosource` (OR-19, R21.6). Without it no replies are sent.
